subject: Re: JaxBARF kickoff — pose refinement without SfM
body: Handoff recommendation, closing out the window: adopt for the capture pipeline, with a staged rollout. Evidence: parity with the reference implementation on the Blender benchmark, plus robustness to ~15-degree pose noise on partner-style captures — which covers the large majority of the problem cases the capture team logged last quarter. Recommendation shipped to their leads today: JaxBARF becomes the pose-refinement stage for noisy-pose collections; captures with worse than ~15-degree error still route through the legacy SfM path for now. Follow-on ingestion of the remaining partner collections proceeds per Bruno's schedule ahead of the Corpus freeze. Loose ends: Csilla writes up the perturbation study as an internal note; Vera tags the parity-run configs in the repo. Thanks all — small team, clean quarter. — Lucia
